description: Concrete automorphy data needed to turn Iwasawa monad charges into global holomorphic sections.

flat_character_guardrail.reason: A z-independent character can define a flat line bundle; it does not realize the nonzero Chern-charge data required by the monad.

forbidden_inputs: character-only flat factors for nonzero Chern charges
torus Appell-Humbert data without an Iwasawa transfer theorem
generic constant matrices without lattice action and charge-to-factor data
